description: Filterable audit log panel for Notion workspace actions.

parameters.name: ActivityProvider
parameters.description: Provider used to query audit entries.

parameters.name: Layout
parameters.description: Result layout: Auto (default) renders both the table and the cards and lets the panel's own container query pick (table on a wide container, cards below 640 px); Table and Cards pin one of them at every width.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the close button is clicked.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of audit entries shown per page.
